name: Prestige - Website Build
body:
> Guide · Prestige · 2026-08-12

# What it is
prestigeplumbingsc.com is a hand-built static HTML site (not WordPress) built by TAG Marketing and hosted on NameHero (docroot `/home5/scottvin/prestigeplumbingsc.com/`). Each page is a folder with an `index.html`. It went live around June 11, 2026. The site tracker workbook (pulled live 2026-06-24) lists 24 pages at that point. By the 2026-08-12 baseline the sitemap held 41 URLs.

# AI-search and technical setup (per the audits)
- `llms.txt` and a machine-readable `pricing.md`, with flat-rate prices that match the HTML and the Offer schema.
- robots.txt allows all crawlers and explicitly allow-lists GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended and Bingbot.
- Site-wide Plumber (LocalBusiness) + Person + PostalAddress schema. Service pages add Service, Offer/OfferCatalog, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList. Blog posts add BlogPosting, Organization and ImageObject.
- .htaccess: HTTPS and non-www 301, custom 404, caching, gzip.
- Global nav and footer link every service, all 6 cities, the blog, about, contact and careers.

# Page structure
- Core (5): `/` home, `/about/`, `/contact/`, `/careers/`, `/404.html`.
- Services (8): the `/services/` hub, plus `water-heaters`, `tankless-water-heaters`, `water-filtration`, `drain-cleaning`, `leak-detection-repair`, `toilets-faucets-fixtures` and `emergency-plumbing`.
- Service areas (7): the `/service-areas/` hub plus 6 city pages. They started at `/service-areas/<city>/` and were flattened on 2026-08-12 to `/bluffton/`, `/hilton-head-island/`, `/okatie/`, `/sun-city/`, `/hardeeville/` and `/ridgeland/`. The breadcrumb is still Home / Service areas / City. See [Prestige - City Page Slug Migration 2026-08-12](lib:brain-prestige-city-page-slug-migration-2026-08-12).
- Blog: the `/blog/` hub plus posts at `/blog/<slug>/`. 3 posts at launch (June 11), 21 published by August 5, and a 7-post sewer cluster staged in `drafts\blog\`. See [Prestige - Blog Inventory and Tracker](lib:brain-prestige-blog-inventory-and-tracker).
- Assets: images under `/assets/img/`. The June audit flagged the hero mp4s as heavy.

# Workbook sheets
- Overview: page counts by section (Core 5, Services 8, Service Areas 7, Blog 4, total 24 at 2026-06-24).
- Blog Calendar: a 24-post, 2-per-month plan from Jul 2026 to Jun 2027 (see [Prestige - 12-Month Blog Calendar](lib:brain-prestige-12-month-blog-calendar)).
- All Pages, Core, Services, Service Areas, Blog: title, URL, path and meta description for each page.

# Local draft copies
`drafts\blog\<slug>\index.html` holds built HTML for 18 posts (11 already-published posts and the 7 sewer cluster posts), with their images. `_sample-post-hard-water.html` is a scratch sample. These raw HTML files do not get their own notes.
